body_markdown:
*Patient Affordability Growth Drives Revenue and Margin Expansion*


*Raises Full Year 2026 Gross Margin, Net Income, GAAP EPS and Adjusted EBITDA Guidance*


*Balance Sheet Supports Continued Investment and Growth Initiatives*


**HENDERSON, Nev. – November 9, 2026 – (Business Wire) –** Paysign, Inc. (NASDAQ:[PAYS](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/pays) ), a leading provider of patient affordability offerings, donor compensation solutions, engagement and management platforms and integrated payment processing for the life sciences industries, today announced financial results for the third quarter 2026.


** “This was a strong quarter, with patient affordability continuing to compound,” said Mark Newcomer, President and CEO of Paysign. “We expanded to 167 active programs and increased the quarterly revenue per program by approximately 32% to $99,524. As that business becomes a larger share of our total revenue, we’re seeing gross margin and operating margin expand together, which is translating into higher Adjusted EBITDA.”


“Separately, our plasma business continued to generate consistent results, supporting investment in our software business,” continued Newcomer. “Subsequent to the end of the quarter, one of our plasma customers informed us of a decision to move their payment processing for 113 centers to another provider where they have a banking relationship. We remain their processor for a number of other centers under existing agreements.”


“Patient affordability is driving our business, and we are seeing demand and momentum continue to build. Plasma remains an important part of our business, and our experience as one of the leading processors in the industry has given us the insights to understand the challenges plasma centers face. That understanding has shaped a software platform that we believe, if cleared by regulators, will offer our customers a value-added way to streamline and more effectively operate their business. The operating and profitability margins for patient affordability are higher than those of our legacy payment processing in plasma, and as we have diversified our business, our corporate margin profile has improved. We would expect our software platform to further enhance that dynamic and unlock incremental operating leverage,” Newcomer concluded.
